# CCTV Guardian for Muse

⚠️ Unofficial integration — potentially risky: this third-party build signs in to your own EZVIZ camera account with your email and password. It is legitimate, but you are trusting it with real credentials — review what it does before installing.

Give your Muse agent eyes. It connects to your EZVIZ cloud cameras for snapshots, PTZ moves, and recordings — all in plain language. A scheduled guardian also watches for motion and sends alerts, with an optional one-sentence AI description of what the camera saw.

Beri Muse agent Anda mata. Terhubung ke kamera cloud EZVIZ untuk snapshot, gerak PTZ, dan rekaman — semua dalam bahasa sehari-hari. Guardian terjadwal juga mengawasi gerakan dan mengirim peringatan, dengan deskripsi AI satu kalimat yang opsional tentang apa yang terlihat kamera.
